mentions.name: Trophikos
mentions.description: This app is a recipe organization app for iOS that collects personal recipes, including food, baked goods, and cocktails, without meal planning or social feed features. It supports manual entry, OCR-based recipe importing, URL importing, and recipe sharing and export. The app is in TestFlight beta ahead of App Store review, with development updates posted on Mastodon.
mentions.problem: Home cooks currently store recipes scattered across Notes, screenshots, and many open browser tabs.
mentions.audience: Home cooks and bakers who keep their recipes scattered across Notes, screenshots, and browser tabs
mentions.source_excerpt:
Hi, I’m working on Trophikos, a recipe organization app for iOS. Not a meal planner, not a social feed. Just a calm, well-designed place to collect your own recipes, food, baked goods, and even native support for cocktails. Manual entry, OCR importing, URL importing, and the ability to share and export.

I’m still actively working on it but just submitted to App Store review. TestFlight is open if anyone wants to try it before launch: https://testflight.apple.com/join/baWAQ4tj
